Thought: I need to identify the functional group that characterizes esters. Let me recall the structures of the given functional groups and determine which one is found in esters.

A. COOH - This is the carboxylic acid functional group (-COOH)
B. COOR - This represents the ester functional group, where R is an alkyl or aryl group
C. NH2 - This is the amine functional group
D. OH - This is the hydroxyl functional group (alcohol)

Esters have the general structure R-COO-R', where one R group is attached to the carbonyl carbon and another R group is attached to the oxygen. This is represented by the COOR notation in the options.
